acceptanceCriteria: A valid repository-bound successor recovery with a terminal successor projects the predecessor as recovered and nonblocking, without rewriting the predecessor close bytes.
An unclosed, mismatched, malformed, foreign, or tampered successor recovery remains blocking and does not bypass close validation.
Focused Rust regression tests prove both the positive projection and fail-closed negative cases.
The implementation performs no partial state writes and preserves the original historical close bytes.
goal: Prevent a recovered historical Work Item from remaining falsely blocked while preserving immutable history and fail-closed validation.
intent: Make a valid append-only successor recovery resolve a historical noncanonical close in Runtime status projection.
